content: Although both representation vectors are used separately to create auxiliary views, the input of each structure is still not restricted, unlike BIBREF20 , where the input is restricted to only previous or future tokens. Because BERT, which is trained by the masked language model, outperforms OpenAI GPT, which uses an autoregressive approach for training as reported in BIBREF14 , we adopt the concept of the masked language model BIBREF37 to obtain both auxiliary views. This approach allows the representation to fuse the left and the right context, which results in a better representation. By using the masked language model, some tokens at each timestep are randomly dropped and denoted as removed tokens INLINEFORM0 ; then, the remaining tokens are used to obtain auxiliary predictions in the dropped timesteps INLINEFORM1 , as shown in Fig. . The details of both auxiliary prediction modules are described below.
